# Business Requirement: Online Bookstore

Develop an online bookstore where customers can browse available books, search by title, add books to a cart, and place orders.

### Functional Requirements
1. Customers can view available books and their prices.
2. Customers can search for books by title.
3. Customers can add books to their cart and place orders.
4. Customers can view their order status.

### Business Rules
- An order must contain at least one book.
- Customers can order only books that are available in stock.

### Non-Functional Requirement
- The book search results should load within 2 seconds under normal operating conditions.

### Business Objective
Provide customers with a simple and convenient way to purchase books online.
Business value: Provide customers with a simple and convenient way to purchase books online.
Details:
Key capabilities:
- View available books and prices
- Search for books by title
- Add books to cart
- Place orders
- View order status

Constraints and business rules:
- An order must contain at least one book.
- Customers can order only books that are available in stock.

# Business Requirement: Online Bookstore

Develop an online bookstore where customers can browse available books, search by title, add books to a cart, and place orders.

### Functional Requirements
1. Customers can view available books and their prices.
2. Customers can search for books by title.
3. Customers can add books to their cart and place orders.
4. Customers can view their order status.

### Business Rules
- An order must contain at least one book.
- Customers can order only books that are available in stock.

### Non-Functional Requirement
- The book search results should load within 2 seconds under normal operating conditions.

### Business Objective
Provide customers with a simple and convenient way to purchase books online.
Title: Add Books to Cart and Place Orders
User story: As a customer, I want to add books to my cart and place orders, so that I can purchase desired items.
Acceptance criteria:
Given A book is available in stock
When The customer adds the book to the cart
Then The book is successfully added to the cart

Given The customer has items in the cart and selects to place an order
When The order is submitted with at least one book, all of which are available in stock
Then The order is successfully placed

Given The customer attempts to place an order
When The cart is empty
Then The order placement is rejected based on the minimum one book rule

Given The customer attempts to order a book
When The book is out of stock
Then The order placement is rejected based on the stock availability rule
Priority rationale: Priority cannot be determined without explicit business ranking criteria.
Assumptions: '- Unconfirmed assumption: Stock validation occurs at the moment of order placement.
Open questions: '- What specific error messages should be displayed when an order violates the minimum book rule or stock availability rule?
